secrets.description: Replicate API token (starts with r8_) used to generate artwork from the whiteboard drawing. Create one at replicate.com/account/api-tokens. Without it, the Generate Artwork button reports that generation is unconfigured instead of producing an image.
Optional override for the pinned Replicate model version hash used for image-to-image generation (jagilley/controlnet-scribble). Only set this if the pinned version is retired upstream.
